evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C08623 message: 'I never made this $49.00 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3530164.
Customer C08623 explicitly reported the flagged transaction 3530164 as unrecognized.
The flagged transaction was preceded by an in-person transaction (3530056) in the same region that received a high model score of 0.622.
The card C08623-K2 has a history of five prior confirmed fraud cases, four of which were for out-of-region use.

case.summary: Customer C08623 reported an unrecognized in-person transaction of $49.00 in region 330. A review of the card's activity revealed a preceding in-person transaction of $116.93 in the same region with a high model score of 0.622. The card has a history of five prior confirmed fraud cases, four of which were for out-of-region use. Based on the customer's explicit report and the card's history of similar fraud, the activity is confirmed as out-of-region use fraud. The card is blocked and a case is created.
